entries.answer: Demand for junior data engineers is steady. About 4,200 openings are listed per quarter in the sample region, up 6 percent on last year. Median pay is 88,000 dollars.
Openings for machine learning engineers grew 14 percent, but most ask for three or more years of experience. Entry-level openings are about a fifth of the total.
Data analyst openings are flat. Employers increasingly ask for SQL plus basic Python, not spreadsheets alone.

Roles that build language-model features are new and labelled inconsistently. Postings that mention retrieval, evaluation or agents rose 31 percent, and most accept a strong public project in place of a degree.
